description: A working text file on a phone is review-only. Navigate to /c/{{SLUG}}. Open Diffs: on a phone it is in the overflow menu: click the button named "More options", then, in its popover (".chat-overflow-popover"), the button whose accessible name starts with "Diffs" (".overflow-toolbar-action[aria-label=\"Diffs\"]"). The ".diff-viewer-overlay" should be visible. Click ".diff-viewer-overlay .commit-picker-trigger"; in ".git-graph-container" click the ".git-graph-row" containing "Working changes". Click the row titled "only.txt" in ".diff-rethink-mobile-files" and wait for the modified Monaco editor to show "after". There is no button named "Edit" in the viewer. Evaluate that ".diff-viewer-rethink .editor.modified textarea.inputarea" has readOnly === true and tabIndex === -1. Tap the "after" line in the modified editor; the rail input ".diff-rethink-rail-input" opens above the rail's Cancel and OK buttons without repeating a code excerpt. Click Cancel without submitting. Call "working-file-content" and confirm it still returns "after\n".

steps.expression: const t = document.querySelector('.diff-viewer-rethink .editor.modified textarea.inputarea'); JSON.stringify({readOnly: t.readOnly, tabIndex: t.tabIndex});

steps.point: (() => { const lines = [...document.querySelectorAll('.diff-viewer-rethink .editor.modified .view-line')]; const el = lines.find(l => l.textContent.includes('after')) || lines[0]; const r = el.getBoundingClientRect(); return {x: r.left + r.width/2, y: r.top + r.height/2}; })()

steps.expression: const ri = document.querySelector('.diff-rethink-rail-input'); const rr = ri.getBoundingClientRect(); const cancel = [...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b=>b.textContent.trim()==='Cancel'); const ok = [...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b=>b.textContent.trim()==='OK'); const cr = cancel.getBoundingClientRect(); const or = ok.getBoundingClientRect(); JSON.stringify({aboveCancel: rr.bottom <= cr.top + 1, aboveOK: rr.bottom <= or.top + 1, value: ri.value});
